_about: THE definition of the Event Manager Report form. One file, read by every surface: the public form (events.themakeupblowout.com/manager-report/), Lauren's copy behind Access (dashboard.themakeupblowout.com/manager-report/ fetches this URL), and — through the `form` snapshot each submitted report carries — manager_report_sync.py in lauren-agent-hub-data, which turns answers into next-event ordering notes. Before 27.10.2026 the field list lived in three places (two pages + FIELD_DEFS in the sync) and had drifted: the sync still mapped two Xime palettes the form had dropped, so Xime Pixie Glow / Euphoria Glitz counts never reached the ordering notes. Guardrail `the-manager-form-is-defined-once`. Keep `key` stable — history and the sync map by key. `short` is the name on the ordering notes; `supplier` is the /inventory/ supplier card whose 'צריך להזמין' list the answer lands on.
